item.description:
# Ghostex 10.43.0
## 10.43.0 - 2026-11-02
**Ghostex 10.43.0 is out.** Side chats, thumbnails of the pictures an agent opens, one view choice of Summary, Normal or Detailed, an OpenCode tab in every model picker with a see-through OpenCode theme, zoom for files, and a calmer chat while agents stream.
### 💬 Chat
- **Side chats fork the session and open beside it.** Side chat in the chat box (or `/btw <question>`) starts a side conversation that knows the chat so far, runs in the same folder in ask-before-edits, and opens as a side panel tab; the main chat's Side chats pill lists them, with Bring back and Delete. - **Pictures an agent opens show as thumbnails.** When Claude, Codex, OpenCode or Gemini reads an image from disk, its row shows the picture, and a folded turn keeps its pictures inside its card in one row that scrolls sideways, with an "N images" count. Click one to open it large. A picture you already pasted isn't shown twice. - **The chat's view is one of Summary, Normal or Detailed.** Simple is now called Normal, Verbose is gone (chats on it open Detailed), turning Summary off always goes back to Normal, and a "Summary view" or "Detailed view" chip at the top of the chat box has an X back to Normal. Default to Detailed view is in Settings > Advanced. - **While an agent works, its steps fold like Claude's.** A running thought folds the calls it made behind "N tool calls", for every agent, and OpenCode's and Codex's many short thoughts join into one Thought row. - **The chat holds still while an agent streams.** A form field you're typing in no longer slides under the caret, and a chat you scrolled up stays where you left it, thanks to @suatkocar. - **Answered forms stay answered,** thanks to @suatkocar: an old answer no longer comes back as "Sending to the agent…", the ? pill counts only questions really waiting, Go to chat reaches an early form in a long turn, and a queued form reads Queued. - **A Stashed pill above the chat box** shows how many prompts this chat has stashed; click it to open just those. - **The scroll marks on the chat's right edge** show only messages you typed, not form answers or messages from other agents. - **The new chat's project and worktree bar** hides as soon as you send the first message. - **Message from and Message to cards** lose their Go to session button: click the session's name instead, which now works for every card. - **The question popup** takes the chat's colours and fits the whole form. - **The menus above the chat box** (Resources, Workers, Links and the others) use the same lighter frosted glass as the sidebar's menus. - **The voice agent panel is frosted glass** like the Notifications menu, with its controls in the header and your conversation on the same glass. - **Slash commands look like the rest of the chat:** a command such as `/rename` shows as your own message, and its output as a quiet note under it, for every agent. - **Paste pictures into question notes,** in chat forms and question pages; they show as Image pills and reach the agent with your answers. - **Question pages get a softer look:** frosted glass cards over your own wallpaper or custom picture on macOS (a soft dusk or dawn elsewhere), and options side by side with a Pick button. - **Page cards show a preview before you open them,** and the preview shows the page's real top.
### 🤖 Agents
- **Every model picker has an OpenCode tab** with the models your OpenCode can use; picking one in a new chat hands it to OpenCode, thanks to @DaveW001 (#390). - **OpenCode gets a see-through Ghostex theme,** so the window shows behind it like Claude Code and Codex. It's used only when you haven't picked an OpenCode theme yourself. - **OpenCode's own session name shows in the sidebar,** and a name you gave it in Ghostex wins, thanks to @DaveW001 (#392). - **The model picker gets a search field** when an agent has more than 6 models, and starred models sit on top in alphabetical order. - **Install hooks repairs a damaged OpenCode settings file** and says why an install failed: the other computer's error, a timeout, an older Ghostex there, or the agent that didn't install. - **Coordinator threads can start on OMP, Copilot, Grok Build, Hermes, Cursor and Gemini** with a chosen model, and effort where the agent has it. - **Codex's footer is read when it says "Fast"** with a capital F, so its model and effort no longer go missing, thanks to @suatkocar.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Handing off a coordinator keeps it a coordinator,** with its Goal and Standing instructions, locally and to another computer, thanks to @diocata (#383). - **A coordinator hears about a thread stuck on a permission prompt** without anyone reading its screen. - **The New Thread picker has a Coordinator row.** - **A handed-off coordinator keeps the title Coordinator** instead of being named after its setup line.
### 📂 Sidebar and files
- **New and never-sent sessions go to Drafts,** which opens and selects the new row when one arrives. - **Notifications keep a waiting permission request unread and red** until it's answered, and the bell turns red while one waits. - **The text of an open file zooms** with Cmd/Ctrl+=, - and 0 like the chat, with a Default files zoom setting, thanks to @DaveW001 (#388). - **The Add a comment box in Files opens beside the text** instead of covering it. - **Filter dropdown rows have a ⋯ button and a right-click menu,** and each row is only as tall as its content. - **The Rename dialog shows Generate** only for long or empty names. - **Settings > Notifications has a Finished-work border switch and colour,** off by default.
### 🪟 Windows
- **Windows: transparency changes apply right away** to every open window, without restarting Ghostex. - **Windows: `file:///C:/…` and `/C:/…` chat links open the file** instead of copying its path, and documents and other files can open in the system's default app, thanks to @DaveW001 (#391).
### 📱 On the phone
- **The phone picks its own sessions list layout** in Settings > Sessions list; Unified lists every computer's sessions together without the computer tabs. - **The Android notification** leaves out coordinators' threads and side chats, and its status bar icon is the seven-petal flower. - **Reconnecting shows a plain spinner** and keeps its gap above the working bar.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Switching accounts brings the Claude conversation along,** completes on an account at its limit, and no longer shows the previous login's sign-in error. - **A signed-out Claude account is restored** from this computer's newer copy of its login. - **Sessions start while the Mac is logged out,** and Ghostex recovers by itself after you log back in. - **A command's auto-detected title goes back** when the terminal returns to its prompt, thanks to @Bet4 (#379). - **Work mode keeps a workspace's ticket command and its masked credentials** (not switched on yet), thanks to @lardissone (#378, #384). - **The onboarding screens show the seven-petal logo,** and the Claude extension's description names the sidebar's top bar.

# Ghostex 10.42.1
## 10.42.1 - 2026-11-01
**Ghostex 10.42.1 is out.** Larger pasted images work in chat, and answers from forms and pages reach a busy agent sooner.
### 💬 Chat
- **Paste images up to 32 MiB on the computer and web.** BMP and TIFF images are sent as PNG, very large pictures are reduced when needed, and the chat box shows the image size and limit if one still cannot fit. OpenCode reduces large images further when sending them. - **Answers from question forms and chat pages send like normal messages,** reaching a busy agent after its current tool call when supported, on the computer and phone. Turn on the Advanced setting **Wait for turn end before sending form answers** to keep the previous wait.

# Ghostex 10.42.0
## 10.42.0 - 2026-11-01
**Ghostex 10.42.0 is out.** The Unified sidebar is easier to filter and organize, chats show failed sends where they happened, sessions have shareable links, and the new Interface page lets you preview and apply your fonts. Update Ghostex on remote computers too so session links and handoff work across them.
### 🧭 Sidebar and sessions
- **The Unified sidebar has a filter bar with chips** for projects, machines, Spaces and session search. Search in the dropdown for a project or session, remove one chip at a time, or open the count for chips that do not fit. - **Remove a project from the Unified list with its row's X,** then reopen it from Recent Projects when you need it. Its sessions keep running while the project is out of sight. - **The Unified sidebar scales to more sessions:** group sessions by project, arrange project groups, remember filters and folded shelves, and use its own hover actions. Machine tabs scroll when many computers are connected. - **Copy Link gives a session its own shareable link.** Opening one focuses the session on this computer or a connected machine, asks before starting its agent, and can offer to restore a closed session. Windows and Linux open `ghostex://` links too. - **`ghostex://terminal` links are removed** because they ran commands with no prompt. - **Handoff / Export has a simpler dialog** for sending a conversation to an agent in this project, another project or another computer, or saving it as Markdown. Drag a session to a Project sidebar project to hand it off there.
### 💬 Chat and worktrees
- **Failed sends stay in the thread with the real reason, Retry and Fix it.** The session gets a red dot and a Not sent notification until you deal with it; a mode that the session cannot use is greyed out with instructions. - **A queued message or answer that stops progressing says what is known and can be removed,** instead of spinning or claiming it is still waiting. - **The new chat's worktree tray can use a new or existing worktree,** creating a new branch when you send the first message and remembering your choice per project. - **The `$` picker includes enabled Claude Code plugin skills and commands** under their `plugin:name` names, thanks to @roypadina. - **Chat Resources covers the whole conversation,** and forms and charts open in a floating view where you can read or answer them. The Resources list calls coordinator pages Worker pages. - **Accounts & limits marks the active account and shows a problem on its row,** with Reconnect when it helps. The Usage panel has a clearer layout and shows when its limits were updated.
### 🎨 Interface and integrations
- **Settings > Interface puts App font, Monospace font, Text strength and Default chat zoom together.** Pick a font, see it in the live preview, then press Apply. The monospace choice reaches terminals, code, diffs and chat code blocks; sidebar icons follow Sidebar zoom. - **Colourfulness reaches Full,** so a dark sidebar and work area can take the theme colour you picked. - **Settings > Integrations groups each computer use, hidden screen and embedded browser tool with its skill and permissions,** so their install and setup controls stay together. - **A coordinator can use Low effort** when its agent offers it. The start level stays High. - **Kanban cards show Blocked by and Blocks,** including links added by an agent, and refuse a dependency loop. - **Linear pull request links are accepted only when they are GitHub pull request links.** - **Work tickets explain invalid icons and unfinished answers more clearly,** thanks to @lardissone.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Chat shows failed sends and unavailable modes like the computer,** and its Theme page is now Interface. - **Android terminals allocate scrollback as it is used,** reducing memory pressure when several terminals stay warm. - **iOS scrollback uses the selected row limit correctly,** so a terminal can retain the history you chose.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Linux AppImages start on a clean offline computer,** and the packages support Ubuntu 22.04. When the embedded browser cannot download while offline, its window explains that and retries. - **Windows explains when its session host is missing or blocked,** thanks to @ilmimris. - **Remote connections wait through slow responses and repair a missing or broken session runtime** when they reconnect. - **Ghostex keeps settings and saved remote machines after a crash or power loss.** - **A Claude session in Bypass Permissions mode continues past its startup warning,** and the chat's Alt+S shortcut stashes a prompt again. - **Browser tools stay on pages in their agent's project,** and Kanban blockers and browser tabs receive clearer help.

# Ghostex 10.41.0
## 10.41.0 - 2026-10-30
**Ghostex 10.41.0 is out.** A Unified sidebar lists every session from every computer, Space and project in one list, the agent button remembers its pick per project, the voice agent can stop sessions and start coordinators, Dictate says why it failed and can use an OpenAI key, and queued messages that got stuck now unstick themselves. Update Ghostex on your remote computers too: several fixes live in the background service.
### 🧭 Unified sidebar
- **A new Unified sidebar (Settings > Sidebar & Sessions > Sidebar) lists every session from every computer, Space and project in one list.** Today's sidebar stays the default, now called Project sidebar. - **Each session is a card:** the project's icon and name (with the computer's name when it runs elsewhere), its status with a live timer (Working, Waiting, Question, Approval, Failed, Done), its title, and its branch, pull request and agent. - **Sessions are ordered by when they last needed you,** never by output while an agent works; Drafts (sessions you haven't sent anything to) sit at the top, then pinned ones. - **Working, Snoozed and Parked fold into shelves at the bottom,** with a Working section switch of its own, and hovering a card offers Snooze and Park. - **The filter narrows the list to computers, Spaces or projects,** and the same repository on two computers counts as one project, named after the repository. Picking a project in Quick Access > Projects filters to it. - **The header's New session button opens the agent picker,** and right-clicking any card opens its session menu.
### 💬 Chat
- **Reply:** the transcript's selection menu has Reply, which opens a small box to type a reply; Add to prompt puts the quote and your reply at the end of the chat box, and Send reply (Cmd+Enter) also sends it. On the computer and the phone. - **Chat Resources lists unanswered questions oldest first,** so they read in the order they were asked. - **Hovering a For later question offers Back to open and Remove without answering;** a removed question reads Canceled, opens to read and takes no answer. - **A queued message stuck behind an input box Ghostex can't read now unsticks itself:** fresh reads, a redraw, a small resize, then the normal send path or Not sent with Retry, and every waiting row says why after a minute. - **Answers, queued messages, Send now and Retry wake a sleeping session** and arrive once it is up. - **Pages no longer show a note box under each option;** Pick and each question's own note stay. - **The View menu is a Simple, Detailed or Verbose choice plus Summary,** kept per chat.
### 🎤 Voice and Dictate
- **Tell the voice agent to stop a session and it stops that session's turn right away,** like the Stop button; it asks first only when it isn't sure which session you mean. - **"Start a coordinator in Ghostex to …" starts one right away,** with what you said as its first message. - **When Dictate fails, a two-line card says why** (no key, key refused, offline, rate limit, out of credit, bad audio) with Add key or Check key opening the right Settings field. - **Dictate uses your OpenAI key when no xAI key is saved,** and Settings > Extensions > Voice agent shows both keys even while the voice agent is off.
### 🤖 Agents and coordinators
- **The agent button remembers its pick per project:** Settings > Agents > Remember the agent you pick switches between Per project, Per Space and Everywhere, and the header button, Cmd+Shift+O, the command palette and the New Thread picker follow it. - **The coordinator effort picker offers Medium, High and XHigh,** and a new coordinator starts on High. - **The New Thread picker is wider so its key hints fit on one line,** its scrollbar shows only while scrolling, and Claude (cloud) gets an orange cloud icon.
### ⚙️ Settings
- **Session notes is a built-in extension (Settings > Extensions), off by default.** Turn it on to get notes back in menus, the chat box and the hotkey; notes you already wrote are kept. - **Every Settings page ends with a folded Advanced section** instead of a Show Advanced switch. - **Menus, popovers, small dialogs and tooltips take a darker frosted glass on macOS,** and the Changes tab's Commit and agent menus are solid so the diff never shows through.
### 📱 On the phone
- **The phone's layout gets iPhone Duo support work:** the terminal slides in, the tab strip peeks, and the keyboard moves smoothly on every phone, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The phone remembers its agent pick per project,** following the computer's setting, and hides Session notes while that extension is off.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Quick Access > Sessions shows your closed sessions again on macOS** (it was empty after ZCode quit), and restoring one keeps it open so you can bring back several in a row. - **History from Cursor, ZCode, Hermes, OpenCode and other agents reads again on macOS** after that agent quits, without ever writing to it. - **A `claude -p` or Agent SDK run started by another program from a Ghostex terminal no longer takes over that terminal's session.** - **Answering a Claude question no longer fails with "where its highlight sits could not be read"** (#350); if it still can't place the answer, it sends it as a message, and a real refusal offers Open terminal. - **Windows: a timed-out git or gh command ends everything it started,** not only the command (#351), thanks to @lardissone. - **A successful git fetch for worktrees and pull requests no longer reads as failed** when a leftover process holds its output (#352), thanks to @lardissone.

# Ghostex 10.40.0
## 10.40.0 - 2026-10-29
**Ghostex 10.40.0 is out.** Settings split General into six pages under App, Setup and More, the chat's pills move into a strip along the chat box, full-window Claude takes over the whole window, dialogs and menus turn to frosted glass on macOS, and tool call cards arrive as a preview. Update Ghostex on your remote computers too: the Work page's tickets changed in the background service.
### ⚙️ Settings - **General is split into six pages:** Chat, Sidebar & Sessions, Terminal, Notifications, Files & Links, and Power & Sleep, and the Settings sidebar lists every page under App, Setup and More. Sleeping Sessions moved to Sidebar & Sessions, and Experimental and Reset to defaults moved to About. - **Show Advanced never hides a page:** Workspaces, Cloud Boxes, Open In, OS Integration and Debugging always stay in the Settings sidebar, and Show Advanced only shows or hides rows inside pages. - **Settings > Integrations has a Web runtime row** for the Chromium runtime with its status, Install, Reinstall and Uninstall; the Extensions store no longer lists it. - **Session status is always Combined:** the Session status from setting is gone, and every session uses Ghostex's own detection plus what the program reports about itself. - **A Session tooltips switch** (Sidebar & Sessions > Session Cards, on by default) turns off the hover tooltip on sidebar session rows.
### 💬 Chat - **The pills move into a soft strip along the top of the chat box,** the bar above it keeps only the working line, and each pill's menu opens right above the pill you clicked. - **Tool call cards (preview, Settings > Chat, off by default):** one card per burst of tool calls with stacked icons, results and times, failures that say why and app logos for MCP tools; they fold once done and show on the phone too. A Codex command that failed inside a script shows its exit code. - **Chat Resources has two groups,** Unanswered (For later included) and Earlier (answered questions, pages, charts and withdrawn ones, told apart by icon and colour), and long chats load it a page at a time. - **The ? pill steps only through questions still waiting** that aren't For later; with none waiting, a click opens Chat Resources. - **The Tasks pill and the Session details Tasks card show every open task,** the 4 newest done ones, and Show more for the rest. - **Links read #270+** in the chat's Links pill and the sidebar badge (no repo name, no count), in the header's muted colours, and the Links pill comes last. - **Session details' folds ease open and shut,** and its account row shows the email alone. - **Message from and to cards** read the session name as part of the title and show the agent's icon once. - **The chat's More menu has Session note,** and the terminal view's buttons follow the chat's order, with Session note, Stash prompt and Saved prompts in More. - **A folded approval card shows the row Cmd+Enter answers and the No that Escape answers.** - **The working bar drops the elapsed time,** and Claude Code's own update notices no longer reach the chat.
### 🧭 Coordinators - **Thread reports arrive on their own:** a report held for an idle Claude coordinator whose input box can't be read gets its screen redrawn, so it no longer waits until someone opens the coordinator. Copy Report masks session refs, names, paths, emails and ids. - **The sidebar row reads at a glance:** the links badge is a plain #348 before the workers count, and the crew icon shows only while a thread works, waits on you or waits for approval. - **The Workers menu header reads "2 active · 429 total".**
### 🖥️ Full-window Claude - **Turning Claude on fills the window:** it hides the sidebar, side panel and Commands pane, the header keeps the sidebar's top-row buttons, and turning it off restores the layout. - **Opening any session turns Claude off,** and showing the sidebar returns to the Space, project, session and layout you came from. - **The Claude button moves to the sidebar's top row** in its grey; the Issues briefcase leaves that row (Issues stays in Open a view, its hotkey and the session chips).
### 🪟 Frosted glass and tooltips - **macOS, with transparency on:** Settings, Search by Prompt, Agents Hub, Quick Access, Browser History and the New Thread picker get a darker frosted fill, and Send Bug / Feedback and 20 other dialogs, the Notifications, Tips & Tricks, Resources and Dev servers dropdowns, and the terminal bar's ⋯ menu and flyouts are frosted too, with a quarter more blur and a 45% dark tint. - **Every plain tooltip uses the same roomy look,** centred with a gap, with shortcuts as key caps. - **The sidebar's icons and machine tab names take the header's colours,** and a machine tab shows a tooltip only when it has an error or a waiting update. - **The Files sidebar drops the Project Docs label** above the tree.
### 📱 On the phone - **Chat improvements reach phones over the air** without a new app install, starting with this release. - **Tool call cards, the plain links badge and the quieter crew icon** match the computer.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **Antigravity:** messages no longer fail with "The terminal draft could not be cleared" while its Accept edits, Auto, Plan or Best-of-N hint shows in the input box (#349). - **Adding a second Claude account no longer says "Login did not complete"** after it was saved, and a real failure shows its reason (#347). - **Windows: Ghostex no longer closes when a monitor is plugged in or unplugged** (#346), thanks to @Dev-Mriganka. - **Agents installed through mise start without any shell setup;** Install fetches mise itself and Node.js when npm is missing, and a missing agent command offers Install on its card. - **Work:** Linear and GitHub tickets share one ticket shape, the groundwork for more ticket sources, and GitHub issue details keep their assignee and labels, thanks to @lardissone. - **Remote:** clicking into a remote session clears its blue dot on its own machine too. - **Linux and Windows:** a click into an embedded web page closes an open sidebar menu or titlebar dropdown. - **Page text boxes wrap long lines** instead of widening the page.

# Ghostex 10.39.0
## 10.39.0 - 2026-10-28
**Ghostex 10.39.0 is out.** Linux works like Windows from the first run on Omarchy and other Hyprland desktops, and the AppImage updates itself. Agents show as pills you can click and mention with +, DeepSeek Harness joins the agents, Orchestrators are Coordinators again, the bar above the composer gets two rows, a Resources pill and a Links pill, and GPT 6.1 Terra joins Codex.
### 🐧 Linux
- **The AppImage updates itself like Windows:** Download update fetches the new version, checks its signature against the Ghostex key built into the app, and Restart and update swaps it in and relaunches, going back to the old version if anything fails. deb, rpm, tarball and AUR installs keep the update notice. - **Omarchy and Hyprland treat Ghostex's small windows as floating:** the setup window, popups, menus, tooltips, the Running Agents panel and Docs note windows no longer tile, and a dialog's close button, toast buttons and chat suggestions can be clicked. - **Omarchy's Super+C and Super+V copy and paste in Ghostex** without stopping a running command; Ctrl+Insert and Shift+Insert also copy and paste in text fields on Windows and Linux. - **No light flash at launch on a dark desktop,** and the setup's System appearance follows the desktop. - **Links open in Wayland-only browsers:** the intro video, Settings links, Open In, Reveal, the update dialog and sign-ins inside agent sessions no longer do nothing on Omarchy. - **Dropping a file onto a chat or the terminal works on Hyprland,** from X11 and Wayland file managers. - **Clicking a notification opens its session or browser tab,** and browser page notifications show once. - **Middle-click pastes the selection in the terminal,** as in other Linux terminals. - **Computer Use can see the screen on Hyprland and Sway.** - **When the background service can't start, the sidebar says why within seconds** (a taken port names the program holding it) with Try again, on Linux and macOS. - **First run on Linux:** a folder chooser when the system has none, the AppImage adds Ghostex to the app launcher, and the ghostex command goes to ~/.local/bin; Settings > Integrations says why the command isn't usable and gives the PATH line to copy. - **Looking for agents never installs them:** Omarchy's install-on-first-run commands count as not installed until you start that agent.
### 🤖 Agents
- **Agents show as pills:** a mention of another session, and every message between agents, shows a +Session pill with the agent's logo, and a click switches to that session. - **Type + in the chat box to mention another agent in the project;** Copy ID copies a session's mention to paste into another chat, and Copy Details tells the agent to run `ghostex agents`. - **DeepSeek Harness is a supported agent** (under More agents): Chat View, install and update from Settings > Agents through mise, and its models and reasoning levels in the model menu and the chat's model pill. - **Orchestrators are called Coordinators again,** and `ghostex coordinator` is the command (`ghostex orchestrator` keeps working). The chat's Threads pill is now Workers. - **GPT 6.1 Terra joins the Codex models,** and Cursor adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 with its current ids and effort levels. A small ⓘ beside Codex's Fast notes that Codex keeps Fast for new sessions too.
### 💬 Chat
- **The bar above the composer takes two rows when the working text doesn't fit:** the current action on top, the pills below, with a short animation, and it doesn't jump back and forth during a turn. Pills that don't fit scroll with a soft fade at the edge. - **A Links pill in that bar replaces the links in the chat's top bar,** with one link's ID and +N (`SPX-123 +2`); the sidebar's links badge shows the same, and a pinned link becomes the badge's ID. - **Suggested links open unfolded when a session has 2 or fewer links.** - **A Resources pill opens Chat Resources,** and the ? pill jumps from question to question. Rows show how long ago they were asked, without question numbers, and a button puts a question off For later or brings it back. - **The Accounts & limits panel is about half as tall:** each account's 5h, 7d and model limits sit in one row, with reset times in their tooltips. - **@ shows a file pill only for a file or folder that exists in the project,** so npm packages and handles stay plain text. - **Pages agents show in the chat fit a phone:** columns stack, small pills stay on one line, and wide mockups scroll inside their own box. - **The Running Agents panel opens with its top 3 projects expanded,** and with every session-card hover button turned off, hovering a sidebar row no longer changes it.
### 🔌 Remote computers
- **A machine that points back at this computer says so** and never installs or updates a background service there. - **Editing a machine reconnects at once,** the Settings tile shows why a machine can't connect, ~/ paths work when adding a remote project, and removing a machine closes its connection.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Answering Claude's question and approval cards works with Claude Code 2.1.311's files panel open,** No clears the approval, and a refused tool call ends the turn instead of leaving the session working. - **Picking GPT 6.1 Terra works,** new Codex sessions show their model before the first message, and a stale red Copy Report clears once an approval closes. - **On the phone, Send stays above the keyboard** however long the message is. - **Files no longer gets stuck on a file that was deleted.**
